verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled jobs, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is the Batch API, which runs a one-off asynchronous batch within a 24-hour to 7-day window. That is not a recurring schedule, cron, or workflow trigger, and nothing in the pack documents scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
